results.title: Musician Lucius Banda’s honour on August 22
results.description: Two years after his death, Malawians are set to converge at Balaka Stadium for a memorial concert in honour of fallen music icon Lucius Banda. The event will also see the launch of The Lucius Banda Foundation, a charity set to continue with initiatives that the people’s ‘Soldier’ used to run. Remembered: Banda. | Nation ...
